definitions.gloss: tea gathering, tea ceremony event, tea party
definitions.explanation: A formal or semi-formal gathering where tea is prepared and served according to the traditions of Japanese tea ceremony ({茶道|さどう}). Can range from intimate sessions with a few guests to large-scale public events.

examples.japanese: {茶会|ちゃかい}に{招|まね}かれた。
examples.english: I was invited to a tea gathering.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}の{大|おお}{茶会|ちゃかい}が{公園|こうえん}で{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: A large autumn tea gathering will be held in the park.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて{茶会|ちゃかい}に{参加|さんか}したとき、{作法|さほう}がわからず{緊張|きんちょう}したが、{亭主|ていしゅ}が{丁寧|ていねい}に{教|おし}えてくれた。
examples.english: When I attended a tea gathering for the first time, I was nervous because I didn't know the etiquette, but the host kindly taught me.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
{茶会|ちゃかい} refers specifically to gatherings centered on the Japanese tea ceremony ({茶道|さどう}). At a {茶会|ちゃかい}, the host ({亭主|ていしゅ}) prepares {抹茶|まっちゃ} (powdered green tea) and serves it to guests along with {和菓子|わがし} (Japanese sweets). Guests follow established etiquette for receiving and drinking the tea.

Larger public {茶会|ちゃかい} are often held at temples, parks, or cultural centers and are open to beginners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶会|ちゃかい}を{開|ひら}く (hold a tea gathering)
- {茶会|ちゃかい}に{招|まね}く (invite to a tea gathering)
- {大|おお}{茶会|ちゃかい} (large tea gathering / tea festival)
- {野点|のだて}{茶会|ちゃかい} (outdoor tea gathering)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {茶道|さどう}: the way of tea, tea ceremony (the art form itself)
- {茶席|ちゃせき}: tea ceremony seat/session (the individual sitting where tea is served)
